probe_user: Probe this machine and write the install.md.{{#target}} Target: {{target}}{{#target_here}} (a folder here){{/target_here}}.{{/target}}{{^target}} No target given: find the most likely user-installed project among what runs.{{/target}}
probe_guidance:
Lessons from probes of other projects (general habits that recovered what earlier probes missed; apply them where they fit this machine):
{{text}}
probe_format_problems: The saved install.md cannot be replayed: {{problems}}. Fix the format (step headings are '## Step <n>: <id> - <title>', blocks are requires, detect, install or verify) with write_install_md, then finish.
probe_not_saved: No install.md is saved yet. Call write_install_md with the complete document, then finish.
probe_halfway: You are halfway through your budget ({{turns}} of {{max_turns}} turns) and no install.md is saved. Call write_install_md now with a complete first draft from what you know; use the remaining turns to fix failing checks and fill gaps.
probe_parse_failure: Your last reply was cut off or could not be parsed, most likely because the install.md inside a tool call was too long. Do not put the document in a tool call: reply with the complete install.md as a plain message starting with the --- front matter. Keep it compact: one or two sentences of prose per step, one block per kind unless this machine needs a variant.
probe_final: Your investigation budget is spent. Call write_install_md now with the complete install.md from what you have found (mark guesses in the prose), then call finish. Only those two tools are available.
probe_unchanged_hint: Look for what the install.md does not cover yet: configuration files and settings (environment variables, time zone, language, paths), users and admin accounts, data and storage directories, ports, pinned versions, and the services that must run. Check those with the tools, add what you find, then save again.
agent_user_steps:
Install {{name}}. The steps, with the blocks chosen for this machine and each block's safety tier:

{{plan}}
doctor_apply_offer: You may apply these with apply_change, which checks again that the change is needed, asks the user to confirm, applies it and measures again: {{items}}. Call apply_change once for each of them before finish; the user decides at the console.
doctor_out_of_calls: You have used all your tool calls. Call finish now with your best diagnosis.
doctor_continue: Continue: use a tool to check something, or call finish with root_cause, evidence, fix and confidence.
doctor_invalid_json: error: arguments are not valid JSON: {{arguments}}
loop_parse_failure: Your last reply was cut off or could not be parsed. Reply again, much more briefly.
loop_unchanged_hint: Use the remaining turns to find what the result is still missing, then save the improved version.
loop_final: Your investigation budget is spent. Call {{finish}} now with what you have.
loop_repeating: Your last reply started repeating the same text over and over and was stopped. Reply again without repeating yourself: keep lists short, name each item once, and do not extend a path or pattern by repeating a segment.
loop_keep_repeating: Your replies keep repeating themselves. Using only what you already know, write the result now with {{tools}}: keep it compact, name each package or setting once, and leave out long lists.
loop_continue: Continue: use a tool, or call {{finish}}.
loop_invalid_json: error: the arguments ({{chars}} characters) are not valid JSON, so the call did not run. Invalid arguments are usually a reply cut off at the length limit, often because it kept repeating itself. Call {{name}} again with shorter arguments. They began: {{start}}
loop_budget_spent: not run: the budget is spent; only {{tools}} are available now.
loop_unchanged_write:
not run: this is the same document your last {{name}} saved, so its checks would give the same result. You have {{left}} of {{max_turns}} turns left. {{hint}} Call {{finish}} if nothing is missing.

[This is call {{count}} with the same arguments and the same result; repeating it will not change anything.]
loop_blocked_call: not run: this exact call already returned the same result {{count}} times. Use that result, or take a different approach.
loop_same_result: [This is call {{count}} with the same arguments and the same result; repeating it will not change anything. Use a different tool or approach.{{#last}} It will not be run again.{{/last}}]
loop_not_run: [Not run from your last reply: {{calls}}. Make each call once.]
loop_not_run_over_cap: {{count}} calls beyond the limit of {{max}} per reply
loop_dropped_turns: [Your earliest turns were removed to make room. The calls they made, oldest first, each with the first line of its result:]
loop_blocked_move_on: {{count}} of your calls were not run because they repeat earlier calls whose result will not change. You already have those results: stop re-checking and move on, and write or revise the result with {{tools}} from what you know.
loop_blocked_result_only: {{count}} repeated calls have been blocked. For your next reply only {{tools}} are available: use them now with what you have found.
